definitions.explanation: A public performance of music, typically classical or traditional. The standard formal term for a concert in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {演奏会|えんそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought tickets for the concert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演奏会|えんそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to hold a piano recital next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演奏会|えんそうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{第九|だいく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}される→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: Beethoven's Ninth is performed every year at the year-end concert.

notes:
{演奏会|えんそうかい} is the standard term for a concert, mainly used for classical and traditional Japanese music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演奏会|えんそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a concert
- {演奏会|えんそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a concert
- {定期|ていき}{演奏会|えんそうかい}: regular/subscription concert
- ⟦{独奏|どくそう}→独奏：07539_dokusou⟧{演奏会|えんそうかい}: solo recital

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧: concert (broader use; also for pop/rock)
- ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧: live performance (pop, rock, jazz — casual)
- ⟦リサイタル→リサイタル：27701_risaitaru⟧: recital (solo performance)

USAGE:
{演奏会|えんそうかい} sounds formal and is associated with classical music. For pop or rock events, Japanese speakers use ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧ or ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧ instead.
